test_title: PYST 8: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 11 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

Rahul thinks he is as smarter as his friends in the class.
solution:
The correct answer is 2 i.e.this part of the sentence contains an error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "he is as smarter as" is grammatically incorrect.
 
• The correct comparative structure is "as + adjective + as" when comparing two things that are equal in some way.
 
• Therefore, it should be "he is as smart as" instead of "he is as smarter as".

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

Correct sentence: *Rahul thinks he is as smart as his friends in the class.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The structure "as + adjective + as" is used to make comparisons indicating equality.
 
• "Smarter" indicates a comparative degree and does not fit in the "as ... as" structure where the positive degree adjective "smart" should be used.
